fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: Strikes a target up to 7 tiles away that is at or below 25% health. It deals 26 damage, up to 1.6 times that at the far end of its reach.

fusions.name: Ride Alongside
fusions.desc: Pulls alongside the target and strikes. It deals 7 damage, leaves the target 6% easier to wound for 3 seconds and has a 50% chance to leave it [Marked] for 8 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Scent in the Slipstream
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 15 seconds, and you move 20% faster for the first 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Gaining Ground
fusions.desc: Against a badly wounded enemy, your damage rises by 12%.
